issues.description: Identifier naming inconsistency for the pixel-writing subroutine: the problem statement and template require a subroutine named 'set_pixel' (problem statement describes set_pixel and template provides an empty 'set_pixel' label), but the solution defines a subroutine named 'write_pixel' (solution_repository/pixel.asm lines 19-34) and does not define 'set_pixel', while main in the solution still calls 'set_pixel' (solution_repository/pixel.asm line 147). This mismatch will cause an undefined-symbol / link-time error and prevents students from directly comparing their implementation to the reference. The expected calling convention (x in EAX, y in EBX, color in ECX, and only EAX allowed to be modified per the problem) is also documented in the problem/template but may not match the solution unless the names/signature are aligned.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the subroutine name and signature consistent across artifacts. Rename the solution's 'write_pixel' label to 'set_pixel' (keeping its body and register saves) or add a small 'set_pixel' wrapper that preserves the expected registers and calls 'write_pixel'. Ensure the implementation follows the problem's calling convention (EAX = x, EBX = y, ECX = color) and preserves only the registers allowed by the statement (only EAX may be modified), so students can implement the named 'set_pixel' as described.

issues.description: The exercise requires a pixel-setting subroutine named 'set_pixel' (problem statement calls it set_pixel). The template provides a stub labeled 'set_pixel' (label set_pixel: in template_repository/pixel.asm). The solution implementation, however, defines the pixel-writing routine under the different identifier 'write_pixel' (label write_pixel: in solution_repository/pixel.asm) while main in the solution still calls 'set_pixel' (call set_pixel). This inconsistent naming (solution defines write_pixel but the rest of the artifacts expect set_pixel) prevents a direct mapping between the required subroutine name and the implemented routine and will confuse or block students trying to locate or implement the expected routine.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the identifier consistent across artifacts. Rename the solution routine 'write_pixel' to 'set_pixel' (and keep the 'call set_pixel' in main), or alternatively rename the template/problem references and the call site in main to 'write_pixel'. Ensure the label that defines the routine matches the name used by main and the problem description so students can directly map the required subroutine to its implementation.
